legal.title: Legal notice
legal.intro: InSeconds is a free music blind test game, available at https://inseconds.cc. This page gives the site's legal notice, in accordance with Article 6-III of French law n° 2004-575 of June 21, 2004 for confidence in the digital economy (LCEN). How your data is handled is described on the Privacy page.

publisher.title: Publisher and host
publisher.body:
InSeconds is published by an individual based in France, acting on a non-professional basis: it is a personal project, developed in the publisher's free time, with no commercial activity (the game is free, with no advertising and nothing for sale).
Under Article 6-III of the LCEN, a non-professional publisher may remain anonymous to the public, provided they have communicated their identity and contact details to their host, which is the case here: this identity remains known to the host and can be disclosed to judicial authorities on request. No publication director has been appointed: this requirement, under the French law of July 29, 1982, only applies to legal entities.
Host: OVH SAS, 2 rue Kellermann, 59100 Roubaix, France, RCS Lille Métropole n° 424 761 419.
Domain name: inseconds.cc.
The source code, text and design of the InSeconds site are the property of the publisher and protected by copyright; any reproduction without authorization is prohibited (except for Deezer music excerpts, see "Music content" below).
For any question, the only means of contact is the email address given at the bottom of this page.

music.title: Music content (Deezer API)
music.body:
Music excerpts (30 seconds), album covers and metadata (artist, title) are provided by the Deezer API and used in keeping with its terms of use (Deezer API Terms of Use), on a strictly non-commercial basis: InSeconds is free, ad-free and generates no revenue.
This content remains the exclusive property of Deezer and its respective rights holders (artists, producers, labels). It is streamed for illustrative purposes within the game, with no download capability, and each track links to its official Deezer page for full listening.
In accordance with Deezer's terms of use, listening to the excerpts is limited to strictly private use within a family scope.
Deezer is a registered trademark of Deezer S.A. InSeconds is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Deezer.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: InSeconds is a free music blind test game, available at https://inseconds.cc. It remains fully playable as a guest, without any account or registration; creating an account, using only an email address, is optional and lets you find your progress again on another device. This page describes the site's privacy policy, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation EU 2016/679). The publisher and the host are presented in the legal notice.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body:
The data controller under the GDPR is the publisher of InSeconds, presented in the legal notice, who can be reached at the contact address given at the bottom of this page.
No Data Protection Officer (DPO) has been appointed: given the volume and nature of the data processed (no sensitive data, no profiling), this is not required under the GDPR. The publisher remains your single point of contact for any question about your data.

data.title: Data collected, purposes and legal basis

cookie.title: Cookie
cookie.body:
A single technical cookie ("__Host-inseconds") is set, whether you play as a guest or with an account. It contains your device's identifier in encrypted form and is used exclusively to run the game (recognizing your browser, resuming a game). It lasts 90 days from your last visit.
If you create an account, logging in from another device (via the link received by email) sets a new cookie specific to that device, linked to the same account: each device keeps its own cookie, and logging out on one does not log out the others.
The cookie of the previous version of the game ("authToken") is automatically replaced by this cookie on your first visit, then removed from your browser.
This cookie is strictly necessary to provide the service: in line with the ePrivacy rules and the guidelines of the French data protection authority (CNIL), it is exempt from prior consent and therefore does not require a consent banner.
No advertising cookies or advertising trackers are used. Site traffic is measured with Cloudflare Web Analytics (see "Data collected"), a cookieless audience measurement tool: it stores nothing in your browser, uses no identifier that could recognise you from one visit or one site to another, and only produces aggregate statistics. It therefore does not require a consent banner. Should a tool that requires consent be added in the future, this page will be updated and a consent banner will be put in place before it is activated.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body:
Game data (answers, scores, win streak) is kept for as long as your identifier or account exists in the database, to feed your history and the anonymous global statistics shown to players. An account with no visit for 3 years is deleted automatically, along with its history, streak and devices (the period recommended by the CNIL), without a warning email. A guest player is not deleted: once their devices are erased (see below), nothing can link them to their games any more, which then only feed the anonymous statistics.
For a guest player, this data is never linked to a real identity: only a random technical identifier connects you to your games.
If you create an account, your history is linked to your email address: that is precisely what lets you find it again on another device. You can delete it yourself from your profile, or upon simple request (see "Your rights").
A connected device (including a logged-out one) is deleted automatically 91 days after its last visit, one day after its cookie expires; a logged-out device can never be used again.
Technical logs (see "Data collected") are kept for 14 days at most, then deleted automatically.
The login link and the link confirming an email change are valid for only 15 minutes and can be used only once; after that time, or once used, they become permanently invalid, and expired links are erased from the database every night.
To carry over players from the previous version of the game without logging them out, a cryptographic fingerprint of their old cookie is kept temporarily; it will be deleted no later than 90 days after the new version went live (October 16, 2026).
Backups: the database is backed up every night. Copies are encrypted and kept for 7 days on the server, and off the server for 30 days (daily copies) and 12 months (one monthly copy) (see "Recipients"). Data deleted from the database may therefore remain in these copies until they expire; it is never restored from them, except after a serious incident.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
In accordance with Articles 15 to 21 of the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict the processing of, object to the processing of, and port the data associated with your identifier or account (email, pseudo, game history, current streak). If you created an account, you can change your pseudo and email address yourself, and view or log out your devices, from your profile; you may also withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before that withdrawal.
From your profile, the "Your data" section lets you download a copy of all the data linked to your account (a JSON file: account, devices, streak and games) and delete your account, by retyping your pseudo to confirm. Deletion is immediate and permanent: it erases your game history, your current streak, your devices, your email and your pseudo. If you can no longer log in, or for any other request, write to the address below: the publisher replies within one month at most (Article 12 GDPR), only to the email address of the account concerned.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (in France, the CNIL: www.cnil.fr).
